oneOf.description: Direct-child roster as `{name, opType}` (capped at 256; see `node.truncation`).
Direct-child roster as `{path, family, opType}` (same 256 cap — does not uncap).

DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

InspectInclude.description: Sections to include in an inspect response.

oneOf.description: DAT text/table bodies and GLSL shader stages (opt-in; not in empty default).

LenientU32.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer; accepts a JSON number or a decimal numeric string.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

OutputContract.description: Output contract selected by an opt-in request.

OutputOptions.description:
Per-request opt-in to version 2 output.

Omission of this entire object keeps the existing legacy response. The
options are strict so a misspelled or future unsupported option cannot
silently change response fidelity.

contract.description: Requested response contract. Currently only `v2` is defined.

retain.description:
Request retention of the captured projection. Omission does not request
retention; `Some(false)` records an explicit inline-only preference. A
producer must reject `Some(true)` when retention is not implemented or
no permitted reader route exists.

view.description:
Requested representation. Omission requests the full representation;
it never implicitly enables compact output.

OutputView.description: Representation requested for a version 2 result.

oneOf.description: Complete selected data using its ordinary representation.
A lossless readable compact representation when supported and smaller.
Return names only, without parameter evaluation or metadata reads.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

childLimit.description: Direct-child page size, default 256; must be 1..256. Requires include nodes.

childOffset.description: Zero-based direct-child offset, default 0. Offsets can shift on mutable graphs. Requires include nodes.

contextPath.description: Resolution base for relative entries in `paths`.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

include.description: Sections to include. Empty/omitted = nodes+errors+warnings; params/content opt-in; non-empty = allowlist.

output.description:
Opt in to the version 2 output contract. Omitting this returns the
existing response unchanged; it never implicitly selects a contract.

paramNames.description: Exact case-sensitive parameter names; omitted/null = all, [] = none. Requires include params.

paramsMode.description: values (default) evaluates selected parameters; names returns only names. Requires include params.

paths.description:
Explicit operator paths to inspect (required, non-empty). Soft-capped at 256.
No auto-recursion — caller chooses exactly which nodes to fetch.
